programsOverview.label: WHAT WE DO
programsOverview.title: Education Designed for Every Child
programsOverview.description: Discover our six comprehensive programs built to make learning accessible, inclusive, and deeply meaningful for underserved communities.

programs.title: Free Education for All
programs.description: Help children from underserved communities access quality daily schooling, foundational literacy, and numeracy to build a strong academic foundation.
programs.imageAlt: Children studying in a bright classroom

programs.title: Digital Learning Labs
programs.description: Introduce children to computers, safe internet research, coding fundamentals, and digital tools that prepare them for tomorrow's world.

programs.title: Books and School Supplies
programs.description: Provide essential educational materials—including backpacks, textbooks, notebooks, and stationery kits—so every student participates with dignity.

programs.title: Girls' Education Initiative
programs.description: Champion equal access to secondary education and empower adolescent girls through scholarships, life-skills circles, and mentorship.
programs.imageAlt: Girls participating in a learning activity

programs.title: After-School Learning
programs.description: Help first-generation learners strengthen their schoolwork through evening tutoring, reading clubs, and small-group mentoring.
programs.imageAlt: Children taking part in an after-school lesson

programs.title: Early Childhood Learning
programs.description: Support young children aged 3 to 6 through joyful play-based learning, storytelling, motor-skill games, and school readiness.

featuredProgram.label: FEATURED INITIATIVE
featuredProgram.title: Every Child Deserves a Chance to Learn
featuredProgram.description: Our flagship Neighborhood Learning Center model brings qualified local mentors, solar-powered digital tools, and a warm library corner within walking distance of underserved families.
featuredProgram.imageAlt: Teacher helping a child with schoolwork
highlights: Safe, child-centered classrooms with low student-teacher ratios
Integrated academic, nutritional, and emotional support

skillsDevelopment.label: LEARN AND GROW
skillsDevelopment.title: Preparing Young Minds for Tomorrow
skillsDevelopment.description: True education goes beyond rote textbooks. We nurture practical problem-solving, digital fluency, creative expression, and empathy.

items.title: Digital Literacy
items.description: Build essential computer, research, and coding skills from an early age.

items.title: Reading & Communication
items.description: Strengthen bilingual reading comprehension, storytelling, and public speaking.

items.title: Creative STEAM Learning
items.description: Spark curiosity through hands-on science experiments, art, and eco-gardening.

items.title: Leadership & Confidence
items.description: Foster teamwork, critical thinking, resilience, and community leadership.

educationalResources.label: LEARNING RESOURCES
educationalResources.title: Giving Children the Tools to Succeed
educationalResources.description: Owning their first school bag and storybook transforms how a child walks into class. Help us equip every learner at the start of term.
educationalResources.imageAlt: Educational books and stationery prepared for students

howProgramsWork.label: OUR APPROACH
howProgramsWork.title: From Opportunity to Achievement
howProgramsWork.description: A structured, community-rooted methodology ensures our education programs deliver measurable, lasting outcomes for children.

steps.title: Understand the Need
steps.description: Partner with village councils and parents to identify out-of-school children and learning gaps.

steps.title: Co-Design the Support
steps.description: Set up safe local classrooms, train neighborhood educators, and prepare tailored learning kits.

steps.title: Learn Together Daily
steps.description: Deliver engaging lessons, digital workshops, and mentoring alongside parents and volunteers.

steps.title: Track & Celebrate Progress
steps.description: Assess reading, numeracy, and attendance quarterly to ensure every child stays on track.

impact.label: OUR IMPACT
impact.title: Every Learning Journey Matters
impact.description: Consistent mentorship and the right tools help children stay in school, graduate on time, and inspire their siblings.

stories.label: REAL STORIES, REAL HOPE
stories.title: Every Child Has a Story Worth Sharing
stories.description: See how access to joyful classrooms, caring teachers, and digital tools is transforming lives across our partner communities.
stories.imageAlt: Students participating in an educational activity

getInvolved.label: BE PART OF THE CHANGE
getInvolved.title: Help Us Open Doors to Education
getInvolved.description: Whether you sponsor a child's annual learning kit or volunteer two hours a week, your support creates ripples across generations.
getInvolved.imageAlt: Volunteer supporting children with their learning
